links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of multi-agent system versus general-purpose LLMs on the same vignettes
links.effect: Multi-agent system 75.2% vs ChatGPT 60.2% and Gemini 58.6% (both p<0.001); hallucination 1.5% vs 15.0% and 9.8%; critical safety errors 0% vs 3.8% and 2.3%.
links.quote: The neurosymbolic multi-agent system achieved significantly higher diagnostic accuracy (75.2%; 95% CI: 66.9–82.2%) compared with ChatGPT (60.2%; 95% CI: 51.4–68.5%; p < 0.001) and Gemini (58.6%; 95% CI: 49.8–67.0%; p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Neurosymbolic multi-agent architecture with a separate compositional verification agent to reduce hallucination

screen.reason: The study tests a newly assembled neurosymbolic multi-agent architecture against monolithic general-purpose LLMs on clinical vignettes. Evaluating model/agent architectures is not testing a deployment practice.
